title: V01-C18 Records and Data Modeling Production Packet

assessment_alignment.acceptance_evidence: A requirement-to-field table that justifies each field name, type, requiredness, default policy, nesting choice, and validation layer for normal, boundary, and invalid examples.
A data-model decision record defining at least three invariants, showing rejected invalid states, construction validation, preservation tests, and one defensible alternative.

accessibility_requirements: Record diagrams label field names and values independently.
Schema-instance comparisons use text labels in addition to color.
Invariant diagrams show accepted and rejected states with reasons.
Turkish terms include English only at first meaningful use.
Code comments and explanations are Turkish.
known_risks: Objects may become unrelated property bags.
Example instances may be mistaken for schemas.
Every field may be marked optional.
Missing and null may be conflated.
Derived facts may be duplicated and drift.
Identity may be confused with structural equality.
Field-level checks may miss cross-field invariants.
Static types may be assumed to validate runtime input.
